items.title: The one role or opportunity AFG wants to recruit for
Hiring targets and how many candidates AFG could realistically consider in the campaign month
Geographic recruiting area and in-person, hybrid, or remote arrangement
Definition of a qualified candidate (experience, licensing, education, traits)
Application and interview process, who responds to leads, and expected response time
Common reasons applicants do not advance
Career value proposition deck (English and Spanish versions)
Summary of training, mentorship, and professional development
Leadership answer: why build a career at AFG instead of another firm?
Support resources for financial professionals (technology, marketing, administrative)
Proof points separated from aspirational messaging
Approved career stories from current team members
Anonymized profile of recent successful hires (prior careers, career stage, motivations)
Top questions and objections recruiters hear from candidates
Interview scheduled: AFG leadership
Interview scheduled: recruiter or recruiting coordinator
Interviews scheduled: two recently hired financial professionals
Interview scheduled: one established financial professional
Interview (if possible): a candidate who considered AFG but did not move forward
Account inventory: every handle and link, with follower counts as of a stated date
Sprout Social export for the last 6 to 12 months (impressions, engagements, engagement rate, clicks)
Top 10 and bottom 10 posts with metrics
Past recruiting posts tagged separately, with results
Content workflow: who creates, who approves, posting frequency, current calendar
Business Casual podcast and YouTube stats, plus episodes featuring career stories
Process for responding to messages and comments
Past paid social results, if any
Career webpage link and interest form (afgfl.com/career)
Brand kit: logos, colors, fonts, Canva brand kit access
Job descriptions for the target role
Recruiting brochures, presentations, email copy, and FAQs
Approved testimonials
Office, team, and event photography and video
List of outdated materials the group should not use
Desired tone and preferred terminology (for example, "financial professional")
Words, phrases, and claims compliance does not permit
Required disclosures and rules for referencing affiliated firms
Guidance on testimonials and on compensation or income messaging
Who approves content and expected compliance review time
Campaign budget and paid social budget (a range is fine)
Staff who could participate and weekly hours available
Ability to edit the career page and create UTM tracking links
Production capacity and equipment (studio, cameras, editing, Canva, Adobe)
Sprout Social availability for scheduling and reporting
Leadership approval turnaround time
Career page visits and form submissions per month
Inquiries, qualified candidates, initial interviews, and candidates advancing
Candidate source breakdown (referral, LinkedIn, job boards, events)
Average response time and inquiry-to-interview conversion
Note of which funnel numbers do not exist yet
Historical cost per applicant or lead, if paid advertising was used
Three to five firms competing with AFG for the same candidates
AFG's view of each competitor's recruiting pitch
Leadership sign-off on what AFG information can appear in a graded paper
Dr. Eastman approves AFG as the client
Permission to use employee names, photos, and quotes

milestones.title: Kickoff meeting held: audience chosen, brief drafted, roles assigned, packet deadline set
Group information submitted (name, members, meeting time)
Requirements checklist built from the rubric
All Priority 1 source packet items delivered
Stakeholder interviews completed and notes shared
Part 2 AFG audit and competitor audit drafted
Part 3 goals, SMART objectives, strategy, and tactics drafted
Section 4 resource plan validated against AFG capacity
Sections 5 and 6 drafted; big idea and platforms locked
Section 7 posts designed, captioned, and named
Section 8 calendar built; optional draft submitted
Introduction, conclusion, and APA references complete
Final rubric check, client fact-check, and proofread
Final paper and team peer evaluation submitted

meta.brief_audience: One clearly defined candidate segment (to be chosen at kickoff)
meta.brief_geography: Southwest Florida, unless AFG recruits more broadly
meta.brief_conversion: Recruiting inquiry, career form submission, or scheduled introductory conversation
meta.brief_platforms: LinkedIn primary; Instagram and Facebook if research justifies
meta.brief_message: AFG offers the support, development, culture, and opportunity the chosen candidate values
